verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is core cap-table software with documented support for share classes/grants, vesting schedules, convertible notes/SAFEs, bulk equity promise uploads, smart-linked data room documents that auto-update the cap table, board/stockholder consents, and ASC 718/409A reporting used by auditors — matching the founder's need for a live single source of truth relied on by investors and auditors. Missing for 10: independent third-party or customer case-study corroboration (all evidence is vendor docs) and no explicit confirmation of real-time investor-facing access permissions.
